findings.fsdQuote: Up to 10 series can be selected from the search results and added together in one step.
findings.note: Add New opens a modal for one search result at a time; there is no multi-select or batch add (only the separate import screen adds many).
The add modal also has Season Folder, Language and Season Type options, and a 'search for cutoff unmet episodes' checkbox, none of which the FSD lists.
Monitor choices include separate 'monitor specials' and 'unmonitor specials' options; FSD lists only 'specials'.

findings.fsdQuote: The episode list of a series can be exported as a CSV file.
findings.note: No CSV export exists in the series details toolbar or the frontend.

findings.fsdQuote: Deleting a series always deletes its folder and all its files from disk.
findings.note: The delete modal has an optional 'delete files' checkbox that defaults to off; files are deleted only if ticked. It also has an 'add import list exclusion' option.
Series details toolbar also has Preview Rename, Manage Episodes (files), History and Expand/Collapse All actions not described.

findings.fsdQuote: Episodes can be dragged to another day to change their air date.
findings.note: The calendar has no drag-and-drop; nothing in the calendar code handles dragging.

findings.fsdQuote: Sonarr can share the calendar as an iCal feed, which covers the previous 14 days and the next 60 days.
findings.note: The iCal feed defaults to the previous 7 days and next 28 days (pastDays/futureDays query parameters).
Calendar also has an Agenda view (besides month, week, forecast, day), plus calendar options and an iCal 'show as all-day events' option.

findings.fsdQuote: Each queue item has a priority (High, Normal or Low) that the user can change to reorder the downloads.
findings.note: No priority field or control exists on queue items.

findings.fsdQuote: Removing an item from the queue always adds the release to the blocklist.
findings.note: Removal offers blocklist choices including 'Do not blocklist', 'Blocklist and search', and blocklist only; blocklisting is optional.
Removal also lets the user choose remove from download client, change category, or ignore the download.

findings.fsdQuote: Any history entry can be undone, which restores the episode file that an upgrade replaced.
findings.note: There is no undo; the only history action is 'Mark as failed', offered only for grabbed entries.
Blocklist screen under Activity is not described.

findings.fsdQuote: Search All starts straight away, without asking the user to confirm.
findings.note: Search All opens a confirmation modal showing the number of episodes before searching.

findings.fsdQuote: A weekly email digest lists every missing episode.
findings.note: No weekly digest of missing episodes exists in the notifications or jobs code.
Cutoff Unmet screen (episodes below cutoff) is not described; the FSD only says they are not on Missing.

findings.fsdQuote: Tag labels may contain letters, numbers, spaces and underscores.
findings.note: Tag labels may only contain letters, numbers and hyphens (a-z, 0-9, -).

findings.fsdQuote: Deleting a tag removes it from every series, profile and indexer that uses it.
findings.note: A tag that is still in use cannot be deleted (conflict error; UI only offers delete when unused).

findings.fsdQuote: Each tag has a colour, chosen from a palette of 12 colours, which is shown wherever the tag appears.
findings.note: Tags have only a label; no colour field or palette exists.
Tags screen also manages auto-tagging rules, which the FSD does not mention.
Quality profiles also have custom format scoring: minimum custom format score, upgrade until score and minimum score increment.
Release profiles (listed on the same Profiles screen) are not described.

findings.fsdQuote: Preferred Protocol: Usenet or Torrent.
findings.note: Protocol choices are four: prefer Usenet, prefer Torrent, only Usenet, only Torrent.

findings.fsdQuote: The default delay profile can be given tags like any other.
findings.note: The default delay profile (id 1) must have no tags; validation requires an empty tag list.
Delay profiles have bypass options: bypass if highest quality, and bypass if above a custom format score (with minimum score).

findings.fsdQuote: Each quality can be limited to a maximum episode runtime.
findings.note: Quality definitions have min, preferred and max size only; there is no runtime limit.

findings.fsdQuote: Each log file can grow up to 50 megabytes before a new one is started.
findings.note: The log size limit is validated between 1 and 10 megabytes.

findings.fsdQuote: Interval: how often an automatic backup is taken, from 1 to 30 days.
findings.note: Backup interval is validated from 1 to 7 days.

findings.fsdQuote: Retention: how long backups are kept, up to 365 days.
findings.note: Backup retention is validated from 1 to 90 days.

findings.fsdQuote: The font size can be set to small, medium or large.
findings.note: The UI settings screen has no font size option.
UI settings also have time zone, header colour and colour-impaired mode options.

findings.fsdQuote: Backups can be copied automatically to an S3 bucket.
findings.note: No S3 or remote backup copy exists in the backup service or settings.
Each backup row can be deleted; not mentioned.
